editorial:
Imagine you are just trying to get away with a bank heist, but instead of running from the cops, you run straight into a horde of hungry zombies. That is exactly how things kick off in the first half of this wild ride. You get to follow a criminal who thinks he has the perfect plan, only to find out that the undead do not care about his money. Then, the second half switches gears to two friends looking for a buddy who never showed up to their meeting. The whole vibe is gritty, messy, and does not take itself too seriously, making it a great pick for a late-night movie session with friends.

What really works here is the fast pace and the amount of blood on screen. The acting is simple, but the action keeps you glued to your seat. While it is a bit rough around the edges, the gore is a huge plus for horror fans. It is a quick, fun watch that does not waste your time with long talking scenes.
endingExplained: In the first story, the bank robber realizes there is no escape as the zombies swarm him, turning his successful heist into a nightmare. In the second part, the two friends find their missing pal, but he has already turned into a monster. The movie ends with the remaining survivors being overwhelmed by the undead. There is no happy rescue coming, just a bloody end for everyone involved in these two unlucky situations.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school zombie gore and short, punchy stories.
